title: ARSIA Compliance Field
description: Compliance envelope field for ARSIA Protocol messages. Declares the regulatory requirements applicable to the processing of a specific message, including the compliance profile, data residency zone, audit obligations, human oversight mode, and GDPR processing basis. The object carries only the members this specification registers (ARSIA-Core.md §4.3.6.1–§4.3.6.9 and clock_skew_seconds, §8.3); additionalProperties is false. Extension profiles (ARSIA-Core.md §4.3.8, Rule 1) define defaults, a retention minimum and an oversight mode, not new members.

profile.description: Name of the compliance profile to apply. Known profiles: GDPR-STANDARD, EU-AI-ACT-HIGH-RISK, EU-AI-ACT-LIMITED-RISK, MIFID-II, PAC-AGRICULTURE, DSA-VLOP, DORA. Unknown profile names SHOULD trigger a warning; in strict mode, unknown profiles MUST be rejected.

allOf.description: Geographic zone where message processing and storage MUST occur. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or supranational identifier. When set, triggers brokered routing (ARSIA-Routing.md §1.2.2).

audit_required.description: Whether this message MUST generate an ArsiaAuditRecord. Default: per profile. When pii_involved is true, the effective value is always true regardless of this field's declared value (Core §4.3.8, Rule 7).

human_oversight.description: Human oversight mode (Core §4.3.6.5). not_required: requests no oversight; a value, not a dispensation. required_before_execution: the action MUST NOT execute until a human approves (Actions §3.2-§3.6). required_within_24h: may execute without prior approval; a post-execution review is opened with a deadline 24 hours after the execution instant (Actions §3.9). required_post_execution: may execute without prior approval; a post-execution review is opened with the deadline of the executor's announced post_execution_review_period, or the request is rejected (Actions §3.9.1).

explainability_required.description: Whether the response MUST include a payload.explanation object (ARSIA-Actions.md §5.2). Default: per profile.

pii_involved.description: Whether this message contains or processes personal data as defined by GDPR Art. 4(1). When true, legal_basis MUST be set.

legal_basis.description: GDPR legal basis for processing. Art. 6(1) grounds: consent, contract, legal_obligation, vital_interests, public_task, legitimate_interests. Art. 9(2) grounds (for sensitive data): explicit_consent, employment_social_security, vital_interests_incapacity, legitimate_activities, manifestly_public, legal_claims, substantial_public_interest, health_medicine, public_health, archiving_research. REQUIRED when pii_involved is true.

ai_system_classification.description: Per-message EU AI Act classification. MAY differ from agent-level classification (ARSIA-Identity.md §1.2) but MUST NOT exceed it.

retention.description: Minimum retention for this message's audit record, as an ISO 8601 calendar duration (Core §4.3.6.4). Replaces Draft-01 retention_days (rejected by this schema). Floor comparison against the profile retention_minimum is calendar arithmetic enforced at runtime (Core §4.3.8 Rule 4).

clock_skew_seconds.description: Informative per-message echo of the profile's clock-skew tolerance. The PROFILE value governs (Core §8.3); a per-message value never overrides it and MUST NOT differ from the resolved profile's value.

art9-legal-basis.description: The Art. 9(2) grounds of legal_basis (Core §4.3.6.8): the bases a SET of a sensitive entry may declare (Core §4.3.8, Rule 8; ARSIA-State.md §2.1.10).
